source_text: In Judaism, Ethiopian Beta Israel communities practiced excision pre-migration, interpreting it through Levitical purity laws (Leviticus 12), but Israeli rabbis and the Chief Rabbinate have prohibited it since the 1990s as mutilation absent halakhic warrant. [26]
